calibration.qualification: Function-header presence in prepared input, not diagnosis accuracy or complete causal body coverage. One new train syntax sample; references used only for post-hoc measurement.

decision: Preserve v3 for valid source and module faults; for observed syntax failure in invalid source, retain lexical function header from the failing source within the unchanged character/token budgets. Do not filter retrieval misses.
missing_definition_policy: Record causal absence separately from function present in failing source; do not invent base lines or discard samples for missing definition/retrieval misses.
heldout_policy: Earlier SWE heldout causal reviews already exist under v3. This change uses only the original50train development inputs plus one TRAIN syntax source and owned fixtures; no new heldout syntax causal source/label was inspected for selection. Freeze before those reviews/exports; no claim that all historical heldout was unseen.
